verdict.rationale: EFTPS lets an enrolled user track payments by email notification, see immediate payment acknowledgement, and view 15 months of payment history. Its public pages also publish processing clocks: enrollment takes up to five business days, and the PIN arrives by mail in five to seven business days. However, none of this is a status lookup for a filing, application or case on public pages; payment tracking sits behind an authenticated login. Missing for 10: a public-page status lookup for enrollment applications, status for filings or cases, and any independent corroboration.
